article.title: Obstruction of driver.
article.content: No person driving a motor vehicle shall allow any person to stand or sit or to place anything in such a manner or position as to hamper the driver in his control of the vehicle.
article.html:
125Obstruction of driver.

Section 125 · Chapter VIII · page 79 of the Act

No person driving a motor vehicle shall allow any person to stand or sit or to place anything in such a manner or position as to hamper the driver in his control of the vehicle.
